fusions.name: Horns Down
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and rams it shield-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 25%.

fusions.name: Herd Surge
fusions.desc: Surges forward shoulder to shoulder and tramples every enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 28 damage that ignores armour. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Close Ranks
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Plods On
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
